lead.title: Democrats take Congress, and Trump admits the Iran war hurt his party
lead.body: Republicans lost both chambers in the US midterms, with some votes still being counted. Trump called the war "worth it" but said it was "largely true" that it cost them.

items.title: Bay of Bengal is mostly calm
items.body: Myanmar's weather department says skies are partly cloudy to cloudy over the Andaman Sea and South Bay, with a few clouds elsewhere.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu struck India, not Myanmar
items.body: It reached Andhra Pradesh on Nov 3 and had weakened to a depression by Nov 4.

items.title: Electrical faults are a leading cause of fires
items.body: Fire Services figures for early 2026 showed 191 fires, 74 of them electrical, with Yangon recording the most.

items.title: World Court to rule on Rohingya genocide case on Nov 19
items.body: Myanmar Now reports the ICJ will deliver its verdict seven years after the case began.

items.title: Thai foreign minister to visit Myanmar on Nov 12
items.body: Sihasak Phuangketkeow wants relations restored and tensions eased after cross-border clashes, ahead of the ASEAN summit in Manila on Nov 16-18.

items.title: Airstrikes reported on schools and a Rakhine bridge
items.body: Myanmar Now reports seven killed in strikes on two schools. BNI reports seven civilians killed at the Yoe Creek Bridge in Kyauktaw.

items.title: Arakan Army's political wing signs India border trade deal
items.body: BNI reports the ULA signed an accord with a Mizoram transport body to formalize cross-border trade.

items.title: Military reinforcements reported on the Chin-Magway border
items.body: BNI reports hundreds of troops moved in two convoys as fighting intensifies.

items.title: Analysts doubt a quick return to full ASEAN standing
items.body: BNI reports they see this as unlikely despite efforts to modify the Five-Point Consensus.

items.title: New US strategy statement gives little weight to democracy, Myanmar Now says
items.body: The outlet says the document focuses on Washington's own goals.

items.title: Report questions dismissals of Myanmar workers
items.body: BNI says a STUM-linked report found 47 of 72 documented 2025 dismissals lacked valid cause.

items.title: Schumer says the Iran war must end
items.body: He suggested Democrats could use their control of funding. Trump says the war will end "whenever I want it to."

items.title: Ukraine's post-war rebuild discussed by European and US delegations
items.body: Ukraine, Germany, France, Britain and the US met NATO and World Bank representatives on Wednesday, the EU said.

items.title: New Zealand votes on Saturday
items.body: The race between Christopher Luxon's coalition and Chris Hipkins' Labour is close to a toss-up.

items.title: EU hopes the new Congress adds pressure on Russia
items.body: Foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas linked the US result to ending the war in Ukraine.

items.title: Grenada holds a snap election today
items.body: Prime Minister Dickon Mitchell is seeking a second term nearly a year early.

items.title: Spain votes on Nov 29 after Sanchez calls a snap election
items.body: Polls suggest the PP and Vox could win a majority.

items.title: EU sets out its 2027 work programme
items.body: The Commission's plan focuses on a stronger, more sovereign Europe.

items.title: Swiss voters to decide on looser arms-export rules
items.body: The Nov 29 referendum matters for neutrality and for countries supplying Ukraine.

sections.mm: နိုင်ငံရေး

items.title: Vance breaks with the war: "The reason we lost is the war"
items.body: The vice president called for an honest discussion about the party's direction.

items.title: Talarico beats Paxton in Texas
items.body: It is the first Democratic Senate win in Texas since 1988. Alaska and Mississippi were still too close to call in early reports.

items.title: Speaker Johnson will not run for minority leader
items.body: A source said Mike Johnson will step aside after the House loss. Jeffries is expected to become Speaker.

items.title: Jeffries projects at least 255 House seats
items.body: He called the result a "tsunami" and is expected to become Speaker. This is his projection, not a final count.

items.title: Schumer is poised to lead the Senate
items.body: He said Democrats won "against all odds." His colleagues still need to confirm him as Majority Leader.

items.title: DeSantis calls the result a "meteor strike"
items.body: He said Republicans face a hard path to retaking the Senate by 2028.

items.title: Trump shrugs off impeachment talk
items.body: He said he is "not even a little bit" worried.

items.title: Harris says Democrats must deliver economic relief
items.body: She also called for holding the administration accountable.

items.title: Oracle raises $20B for AI data centers
items.body: The deal splits into $10B of common stock at $116 a share and $10B of senior notes.

items.title: Shoals and ARRAY agree a $1.32B solar merger
items.body: The all-stock deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027.

items.title: Apple's strong quarter is shadowed by memory-chip costs
items.body: Results beat expectations, but rising memory prices threaten gross margins over the holidays.

items.title: Meta seeks $20-25B in bonds, including its first euro bond
items.body: It expects 2026 capital spending of $135-145B.

items.title: Marathon Petroleum sells two refineries to CVR Energy for $4.2B
items.body: The sale covers Upper Midwest refineries and related assets.

items.title: Thomson Reuters misses revenue estimates
items.body: Q3 revenue of $1.83B came in below the $1.91B consensus.

items.title: Ferrari beats earnings estimates
items.body: It reported adjusted Q3 earnings of $2.81 a share against a $2.66 consensus.

items.title: LS Power proposes buying EVgo at $2 a share
items.body: The offer is non-binding and a special board committee is reviewing it.

sections.mm: စတော့ဈေးကွက်

items.title: The Dow gains 3% as oil drops about 8%
items.body: Stocks rallied on the election result, and Brent fell back below $100 on hopes of an end to the war. Energy was the weakest sector.

items.title: Asian chip stocks sell off on AI regulation fears
items.body: SK Hynix fell 7.4% and Samsung 5.7% in Seoul, after US data center shares dropped.

items.title: Biggest moves: Kyndryl +30%, Amdocs -30%, Trump Media -24%
items.body: Kyndryl held its outlook and Amdocs forecast lower 2027 revenue. Trump Media fell after the Democrats won.

items.title: Crypto recovers alongside stocks
items.body: Prices bounced from overnight losses tied to the Democrats' wins.

items.title: Hang Seng jumps 2.8% as Tokyo tech slides
items.body: Advantest fell 9.4% and Tokyo Electron 7.7%, while Hong Kong has less AI exposure.

items.title: FIS falls about 24% after cutting its outlook
items.body: It lowered its 2026 adjusted EPS growth forecast to 1.2-2.4%.

items.title: Cricut surges 49% on a special dividend
items.body: Q3 revenue rose 11% to $188.6M and it declared a $0.70 dividend.

items.title: Palantir slips despite 96% revenue growth
items.body: Mid-morning shares dipped as total contract value grew only 6%.

items.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device in under a week
items.body: It covered the enclosure, circuit board and firmware, though people still revised it for manufacturing tolerances.

items.title: ChatGPT search nears 20% of Google's volume, OpenAI estimates
items.body: The company also puts weekly users at 1.2 billion.

items.title: Binance says it has recovered about 90% after the $6.3B hack
items.body: The record theft has been linked to North Korea's TraderTraitor group. Binance says users will not bear the loss.

items.title: Google to switch off Search for K-12 accounts unless schools opt in
items.body: Gemini and Search stay off by default for student accounts.

items.title: Brookfield and Drax plan a $27B AI data center in Yorkshire
items.body: It still needs planning approval, network approvals and a tenant.

items.title: Fal raises $1.3B at a $16B valuation
items.body: The AI inference startup reports $800M in annualized revenue.

items.title: Stanford retest finds 44% of cited LLM claims have expired
items.body: Researchers tested 50 claims against 20 models released through September 2026.

items.title: UK warns of AI ransomware on critical infrastructure by 2028
items.body: The National Cyber Security Centre calls this highly likely.

marketNote: Asian figures were taken mid-session, so they will differ from the close. USD/MMK is the Trading Economics listing from Nov 3 and may not match the street rate in Yangon.

words.mm: အသိအမှတ်မပြုဘဲ ငြင်းပယ်သည်
words.meaning: To reject something publicly and refuse to support it.
words.example: Vance repudiated the war after the election.

words.mm: ပြင်းပြင်းထန်ထန် ပြစ်တင်ဝေဖန်ခြင်း
words.example: Voters delivered a clear rebuke to the party.

words.mm: အတက်အကျမြန်သော၊ မတည်ငြိမ်သော
words.meaning: Likely to change suddenly and sharply.
words.example: Oil has been volatile since the war began.

quote.text: By effort and heedfulness, discipline and self-mastery, let the wise one make for himself an island which no flood can overwhelm.
quote.source: Dhammapada, verse 25, translated by Acharya Buddharakkhita

history.label: This month in history
history.title: Mrauk-U was founded in 1430
history.body: King Min Saw Mon founded the city on 16 November 1430. It became the capital of a powerful Arakanese kingdom.
